name: @designfabric/desktop
description: App de escritorio Electron de DesignFabric (tabpane unificado de ClearCut + DesignFabric).

scripts.dev: node scripts/run-clean-env.mjs ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE ELECTRON_SKIP_BINARY_DOWNLOAD -- electron-vite dev
scripts.preview: node scripts/run-clean-env.mjs ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE ELECTRON_SKIP_BINARY_DOWNLOAD -- electron-vite preview
scripts.dist:linux: node scripts/run-clean-env.mjs ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE -- electron-builder --linux AppImage --x64 --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.dist:win: node scripts/run-clean-env.mjs ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE -- electron-builder --win portable --x64 --config electron-builder.yml
